alt: 包裹被雜亂麻繩纏在一起，一名志工果斷用剪刀剪開繩結，讓包裹立刻分開，旁邊原本慢慢解繩的同伴露出鬆一口氣的表情。
scene_prompt: Idiom 快刀斬亂麻: resolve a complicated entangled problem promptly with a decisive action. Contemporary community volunteer packing table. Foreground an adult volunteer with calm decisive expression uses a pair of ordinary strong scissors held correctly in one hand to make ONE clean cut across a dense tangled knot of spare natural packing twine resting on the table, freeing several small plain cardboard gift parcels that had been hopelessly tied together by this tangle. The adult's other hand rests safely well away from the scissors. The severed ends of the knot visibly separate left and right, with short subtle pencil motion strokes at the cut, showing the decisive solution. To the side another adult volunteer had been painstakingly trying to unravel one fine strand and now watches with relieved surprise. Two neatly freed parcels stand on the right, while some tangled cord remains on the left. Focus on the rapid, direct solution to a complex knot, not ordinary wrapping, not destruction of useful belongings. No blades held near anyone's body, no children handling tools, no injury. Exactly two adults, anatomically coherent hands with natural fingers and tool grip, grounded table legs and objects. NO text, writing, numerals or speech bubbles.
